jp:
「あたしも　だじゃれ大会に
　出ようと　ネタを　考えているのよ」
　{KP}
「でも　おとっちゃんや
　お姉ちゃんは　雪祭りの　ことで
　頭が　いっぱいで」{KP}
　
「あたしの　ネタなんて
　聞いてくれないの！」
en: "I'm thinking up material so I can enter the Pun Contest too,"{KP}"but Pa and Big Sis have their heads full of the Snow Festival,"{KP}"so they won't listen to my material!"

jp:
「あたしも　だじゃれ大会に
　出ようと　こりずに　ネタを
　考えているのよ」
en: "I'm not giving up! I'm still thinking up material so I can enter the Pun Contest too!"

"Momotaro-san! I have a favor to ask!"{KP}"For some reason, hardly any snow has fallen this year,"{KP}"so we can't hold the Snow Festival everyone's been looking forward to!"{KP}"So we went to ask {bb}Yuki-onna-san{ww}, who has the power to make it snow,"{KP}"but she blew us away with her Blizzard art!"{KP}"Won't you please use your power, Momotaro-san, and ask {bb}Yuki-onna-san{ww} for us?"{KN}

jp:
「ありがとうございます！
　さすがは　桃太郎さんですね！」
　{KP}
「成功した　あかつきには
　桃太郎さんの　おのぞみに
　なる物を　用意したいと思います！」
en: "Thank you so much! That's Momotaro-san for you!"{KP}"If you succeed, I'll have something ready for you, Momotaro-san, whatever you wish!"
"Please, don't say that. I'm begging you."{KN}

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　お願いしますよ！」

en: "Momotaro-san! Thank you so much!"{KP}"Thanks to you, everyone is overjoyed!"{KP}"I'd like to thank you. If there's anything you'd like, don't hold back!"{KP}"What! ...{bb}Lumber{ww}? I see, I see, that {bb}Dragon God Ship{ww}... Hmm."{KP}"Very well! I'll hand over the {bb}Lumber{ww} we set aside for repairing the Treasure Tower!"{KP}"Let me write you a note!"{KP}Scribble, scribble, scribble...{KP}"Just hand this {bb}Permit{ww} to the keeper of the Treasure Tower, and they'll arrange the {bb}Lumber{ww}!"

"Momotaro-san, have you thought of something you'd like?"{KP}"What! ...{bb}Lumber{ww}? I see, I see, that {bb}Dragon God Ship{ww}... Hmm."{KP}"Very well! I'll hand over the {bb}Lumber{ww} we set aside for repairing the Treasure Tower!"{KP}"Let me write you a note!"{KP}Scribble, scribble, scribble...{KP}"Just hand this {bb}Permit{ww} to the keeper of the Treasure Tower, and they'll arrange the {bb}Lumber{ww}!"

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　ありがとうございました！」
　{KP}
「おかげさまで　みな
　大変　喜んでおります！」
　{KP}
「お礼を　したいのですが
　何か　お望みの物が　あれば
　えんりょなく　言ってください！」{KP}
　
「えっ！
　まだ　思いうかばない？」
　{KP}
　
「よく深く　ありませんねぇ～
　では　何か　思いついたら
　いらして　ください！」
en: "Momotaro-san! Thank you so much!"{KP}"Thanks to you, everyone is overjoyed!"{KP}"I'd like to thank you. If there's anything you'd like, don't hold back!"{KP}"What! Nothing comes to mind yet?"{KP}"My, you're not greedy at all! Well then, come see me once you think of something!"

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　{bb}龍神船{ww}は　修理できましたか？」
en: "Momotaro-san! Were you able to repair the {bb}Dragon God Ship{ww}?"

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　{bb}龍神船{ww}は　修理できましたか？」
　{KP}
「……ほう　それは　よかった！
　龍神船は　わが村に　とっても
　大切な舟ですからね！」
en: "Momotaro-san! Were you able to repair the {bb}Dragon God Ship{ww}?"{KP}"......Oh, that's wonderful! The Dragon God Ship is a very important ship to our village!"
